name: Ren'ai Jugyou ~Oshiego no Yuuwaku~
original_name: 恋愛授業～教え子の誘惑～
source:
Satoshi is a Chemistry teacher. One day, he meets a pretty student at school. They are just a teacher and a student at first. However, she suddenly starts approaching him after a small accident. Satoshi tries to refuse it, but.... Like this, their secret relationship starts....
